From The Grateful Dead · Price: weaker against cold creatures, and it stops on anyone who chills themselves. A cold creature (one with the cold trait, immunity to cold, or a body that isn't warm: cold-blooded animals, most undead, constructs) gets a +2 circumstance bonus to saves against Aging and takes half its damage. A creature chills itself by being in ice, snow or cold water, by taking cold damage, or by spending 1 action (Interact) to cool itself with ice or cold water it holds; while chilled (until the start of its next turn, or as long as it stays in the cold source), Aging has no effect on it. Severe cold or worse (GM Core pg. 95, 12°F or colder) chills every creature in it.

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 1 action: aura of gas, @Template[emanation|distance:20]{20-ft emanation}, for 1 minute (concentrate): non-allies that start their turn in it attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} save. On a failure, a creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{fatigued} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 1} until the end of its turn, and its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained} value increases by 1 (maximum @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 3}); on a critical failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained} increases by 2 instead. Allies are affected only on a critical failure. Or, 1 action: your stand grips a creature within reach and withers it: @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}); @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 1} until the end of your next turn on a failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 2} for 1 minute on a critical failure.
  • 5: Surge: your stand's touch ages a creature rapidly: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]] damage rolled with d4s instead of d6s (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}); on a failure it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} for 1 round; on a critical failure it's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1} for 1 minute.
  • 9: Aura 30 ft, and the aura's maximum @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained} is 4.
  • 13: The touch deals @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 2}.
  • 17: Creatures that critically fail the aura save are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1}.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
